# Avsnitt 606 - Börsens Frank Andersson

**Feed**: fill-or-kill  
**Published**: 2026-11-10  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

The hosts go over the US midterm election, which Democrats won, partly on opposition to new data centers. A few days later came a sharp AI/semiconductor crash, which they blame on hedges being unwound after the vote and on data-center expansion likely slowing. They see the AI trade moving away from chipmakers toward applications and agents, and Europe as a rotation winner on Ukraine peace-talk turnaround plays. Kambi's large AllWyn deal stood out on the company side, and the hosts lean toward a strong year-end rally.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 KAMBI — Kambi | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Large AllWyn deal (€45-50m EBIT over 5 yrs), strong report, buybacks, growth returning; both hosts are long-term owners.

#### Reasoning

Operators are giving up on in-house tech stacks (DraftKings struggling), which favours outsourcing to Kambi's B2B platform and AI/data edge. Growth drops through to the bottom line, buybacks continue, and the ESG discount keeps the valuation attractive. The stock at 165-170 is far below historical levels.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth fails to materialise without a World Cup in 2027
- if operators keep building in-house tech stacks
- if regulatory/ESG pressure intensifies

> *"Ja, och kursen står ju ännu bara i 165-170 någonting. Och tittar man historiskt så har de ju mycket att ta igen här."*

---

### 🟢 NBIS — Nebius | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host bought around 140 and added during the crash; owns it, though it is very volatile.

#### Reasoning

The host traded the AI crash and added to Nebius on the bounce. The election makes US data-center build-out harder, which could make existing compute more valuable, but volatility is extreme.

#### Sell Triggers

- if data-center regulation sharply curtails AI capex
- if the AI crash resumes after the Anthropic IPO

> *"köpte mer Nibius där och ändå tajma de här studsarna"*

---

### 🟠 PATH — UiPath | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

New Google partnership; RPA plus the AI Maestro platform reduces compute cost; host is researching it but doesn't own it.

#### Reasoning

If compute becomes scarce and expensive, deterministic bots handling workflows with AI only at decision points cut token costs. UiPath already serves most Fortune 500 companies and fits the shift toward AI applications and agents.

#### Sell Triggers

- if compute becomes abundant and cheap
- if agent adoption stalls

> *"Jag tittar på den, jag äger den inte än. Men jag tycker att den är väldigt intressant."*

---

### 🟢 LXS — Lanxess | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host owns it; turnaround play on Ukraine peace and lower gas prices; at an all-time low; EU backing for critical chemicals.

#### Reasoning

A weaker balance sheet than BASF but more upside if peace or a ceasefire brings energy prices down. The EU now classes chemicals as critical industry, and the stock is a laggard at all-time lows.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Ukraine peace talks fail
- if gas prices spike again

> *"Jag äger ett litet bolag som heter Lankses som är deras fula inavlade kusin med mycket sämre balansräkning men lite mer schvung om det händer."*

---

### 🟠 BAS — BASF | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Critical EU chemicals play on the same peace and energy-price turnaround theme.

#### Reasoning

European laggard sector backed by EU rules on critical chemicals; would benefit from lower gas prices after a ceasefire.

#### Sell Triggers

- if peace talks collapse
- if energy prices rise

> *"Att vi måste ha en kritisk kemiindustri. BASF. till exempel."*

---

### 🟡 ABCL — Abcellera | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host owns it; strong report with a big cash pile; two new molecules entering the clinic.

#### Reasoning

A strong cash position funds pipeline expansion into ion channels and oncology, and biotech is bouncing after the post-election selloff.

#### Sell Triggers

- if clinical programs fail
- if cash burn accelerates

> *"Stark rapport med brutal kassa och har två nya molekyler på väg in i klinisk fas."*

---

### ⛔ SNDK — SanDisk | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Low P/E is a cyclical-peak trap; host not interested in catching chip stocks.

#### Reasoning

Slower data-center build-out flattens semiconductor growth. Cyclical companies have low P/Es at the top, so P/E rises as earnings get cut.

> *"Men det jag menar är att jag inte är så intresserad av att fånga chipbolag."*

---
